summary: Touch target sizing and mobile ergonomics review.

findings.title: Mobile Add-to-Cart button is 32px height, below 44px/48px touch guidelines
findings.impact: Small target height causes missed taps and customer frustration during mobile checkout.

evidence.snippet: <button className="h-8 px-3 text-xs bg-indigo-600">Add to Cart</button>

remedy.summary: Increase height to min-h-[48px] with padding py-3.
remedy.code: <button className="min-h-[48px] px-4 py-3 text-sm font-medium bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-lg">Add to Cart</button>
